summary: Iteration 2 (Resend dry-run + Stripe subscription) tested. Backend: 35/36 pytest passed (15 new email/stripe tests + 21 regression). Frontend: BillingPage cards, Pro 'Current plan' badge, 'Switch to Enterprise' CTA -> redirect to checkout.stripe.com all working; /verify-email?token=invalid shows error state; /billing/cancel renders 'Checkout canceled'. Dry-run email logs verified in backend.err.log ([EMAIL DRY-RUN] welcome, verify, reset, payment-success).

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 instead of a graceful response when Stripe.Session.retrieve fails. The Emergent test-mode Stripe proxy is ephemeral — sessions created seconds earlier are not retrievable, surfacing as 'No such checkout.session: cs_test_...' StripeError. The except branch maps this to 500. Per review request the endpoint must remain functional and not return 500. Recommend: if Stripe retrieve raises InvalidRequestError ('No such checkout.session'), fall back to returning the cached payment_transactions row (payment_status='unpaid'/'initiated', amount_total/currency from txn) with HTTP 200, or surface 404 with cached snapshot.

action_items: Make /api/stripe/checkout-status resilient to Emergent ephemeral session state — catch InvalidRequestError and return cached transaction snapshot instead of 500.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1190 lines — strongly recommend splitting auth, billing/stripe, admin, scans/builds into separate FastAPI routers (>700 line guideline).

Webhook signature verification is bypassed when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset — fine for dev but ensure production deploy has the secret set; consider failing closed (reject) when env=='production' and secret is empty.
stripe_checkout_status surfaces raw stripe error string in HTTP 500 detail — leaks internal request ids; sanitize.
email_service._initialized + module-level RESEND_API_KEY captured at import time — if the env var changes at runtime, _is_live() still returns False until process restart (acceptable but document).
seed_data_creation: Test users with TEST_ prefix created and cleaned up by tests. Demo user license restored to 'pro' after webhook idempotency test (was set to 'enterprise' transiently).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all backend tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. New file test_email_stripe.py covers register-emails, forgot/verify/resend, checkout pro+enterprise+invalid+unauthed, checkout-status, portal-no-sub, webhook completed+idempotent+invalid. Webhook handler tolerates missing Stripe-Signature when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET unset. Dry-run logs are emitted to /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log via [EMAIL DRY-RUN] prefix. Only failing test: test_stripe_checkout_status — root cause is Emergent proxy ephemerality, requires backend hardening of the endpoint.
rca of the issue: checkout-status 500: stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve(session_id) raises InvalidRequestError because the Emergent Stripe test proxy does not persist sessions across the brief checkout->status round-trip. server.py:879-900 catches stripe.error.StripeError and re-raises as HTTPException(500). Fix: catch InvalidRequestError specifically, lookup payment_transactions by session_id and return {'payment_status': txn.get('payment_status','unpaid'), 'status': 'open', 'amount_total': txn.get('amount_cents'), 'currency': txn.get('currency','usd')} with HTTP 200. Reproduction: POST /api/stripe/checkout {plan:'pro', origin_url:...} -> capture session_id -> GET /api/stripe/checkout-status/{session_id} -> 500.
